top_reviews.text: So the brown color is definitely beautiful!  They do run large, as most cowgirl boots do so buy at least a half size smaller than your usual shoe size. top_reviews.title: So Cute and Eye-Catching Plus Roomy Inside
top_reviews.text: These cowboy boots are so cute and eye-catching!  I love the contrast between the black boots and the yellow sunflower embroidery.  Like any fashion boots, the inside soles are flat.  I love that the interior is roomy enough that I can fit orthopedic inserts inside for cushioning that makes these boots more comfortable to wear.  These boots have a roomy toe box inside which I also like.  My rating is 5 stars for these boots for the stylist sunflowers plus the straps that fit at the ankle level.
